answer.design_quote: The mean and standard deviation (SD) of the changes in the vitamin D and placebo groups were compared using standardized mean differences (SMDs). Random-effects meta-analyses were performed using the inverse variance method to pool the data.
answer.k_quote: The outcomes were reported in 15 studies encompassing data from 962 participants.

design_quote.quote: The mean and standard deviation (SD) of the changes in the vitamin D and placebo groups were compared using standardized mean differences (SMDs). Random-effects meta-analyses were performed using the inverse variance method to pool the data.

k_quote.quote: The outcomes were reported in 15 studies encompassing data from 962 participants.

answer.design_quote: We used PubMed, EMBASE, and Cochrane Library to identify randomized controlled trials using the keyword combination of vitamin D and depression from inception to June 2024.
